title: DeadFlames_Modpack
description: This is a pvp and fps boosting mod pack use by pvpers and low end device players.
body:
# DeadFlames_Modpack

A lightweight Fabric modpack designed to maximize FPS and provide a smoother PvP experience on Minecraft 1.21.1.

## Features

⚡ Massive FPS improvements

⚔️ Optimized for PvP gameplay

🚀 Reduced lag, stuttering, and frame drops

🛠️ Useful quality-of-life enhancements

🌐 Works on vanilla and modded servers

🎮 Lightweight and easy to run on low-end PCs

## Why DeadFlames_Modpack?

DeadFlames_Modpack combines the best performance and utility mods into one simple package. Whether you're playing Bedwars, SkyWars, Lifesteal, SMPs, or other multiplayer servers, this pack helps deliver smoother gameplay, higher frame rates, and a better overall Minecraft experience.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side
* Multiplayer Friendly

## Credits

Thanks to all the amazing mod developers whose work makes this modpack possible.
